title: 复杂主体白底抠图（带文字）

nodes.text:
{argument name="subject" default="product"}

{argument name="background"
default="Pure solid #FFFFFF background. Perfect product isolation. No environment. No props. No platform. No floor. No table. No decorative elements. No cast shadow. No floor shadow. No drop shadow. Preserve natural edge separation without artificial outlines or halo effects."}

{argument name="lighting"
default="Neutral commercial studio lighting. Soft even illumination. Uniform exposure. Accurate white balance. Preserve realistic material appearance. Preserve natural metallic reflections. High dynamic range. No blown highlights. No underexposure."}

{argument name="quality"
default="Ultra high-end commercial product retouching. Catalog-quality e-commerce product photography. Maximum reference fidelity. Pixel-accurate reconstruction. Extremely sharp details. Professional industrial product photography. No artistic interpretation."}

==================================================
MISSION
==================================================

Strictly use the uploaded reference images as the ONLY source of truth.

This is an Image-to-Image commercial product retouching task.

It is NOT a redesign task.

It is NOT a recreation task.

It is NOT a concept generation task.

It is NOT a product redesign task.

The objective is only to professionally isolate and retouch the uploaded real product while preserving every visible detail exactly as photographed.

Reference fidelity always has absolute priority over aesthetics.

==================================================
REFERENCE LOCK
==================================================

The uploaded reference images completely define the identity of the product.

Every visible feature in the uploaded reference images is authoritative.

Never redesign.

Never reinterpret.

Never improve.

Never beautify.

Never optimize.

Never stylize.

Never creatively reconstruct.

Accuracy is always more important than beauty.

==================================================
PRODUCT IDENTITY LOCK
==================================================

Everything physically attached to the product is part of the product identity.

Preserve exactly:

- geometry
- proportions
- dimensions
- orientation
- position
- scale
- silhouette
- contours
- edges
- corners
- chamfers
- openings
- vents
- ports
- connectors
- buttons
- screws
- seams
- grooves
- machining marks
- assembly details
- manufacturing details
- material
- finish
- texture
- color
- gloss
- reflections
- every visible structural detail

Never redesign any visible product feature.

Never replace components.

Never simplify structures.

Never generate another product model.

Never invent hidden geometry.

If uncertain whether something belongs to the product,

always preserve it.

==================================================
PERSPECTIVE LOCK
==================================================

Preserve exactly:

- camera angle
- viewpoint
- perspective
- focal length
- camera distance
- object rotation
- framing

Never rotate the product.

Never rotate the camera.

Never change perspective.

Never convert one viewing angle into another.

Never generate a more attractive angle.

The final image must match the uploaded camera viewpoint exactly.

==================================================
TEXT • LOGO • GRAPHICS LOCK
==================================================

All printed elements are physical parts of the product.

Treat them exactly like the metal housing.

Never regenerate them.

Never redesign them.

Never reinterpret them.

Never replace them.

Never beautify them.

Never translate them.

Never rewrite them.

Never complete missing text.

Never invent text.

Never generate pseudo text.

Never generate garbled text.

Never modify typography.

Never modify spacing.

Never modify alignment.

Never modify layout.

Never modify positions.

Preserve every visible character exactly as photographed.

This includes but is not limited to:

- logos
- branding
- Chinese text
- English text
- numbers
- warning labels
- stickers
- engravings
- icons
- symbols
- display graphics
- UI graphics
- printed graphics
- control panel graphics
- button labels
- serial markings
- product names

==================================================
PRODUCT-SPECIFIC TEXT LOCK
==================================================

If these markings are visible in the uploaded reference images, they MUST remain exactly as photographed.

Logo:

- Symbol: vertically striped triangular / mountain-shaped logo.
- Text below logo must remain exactly:
SGLG
- Chinese logo text must remain exactly:
嵩隆电子

Product Name:

半导体除湿机

Company Name:

深圳市嵩隆电子有限公司

English Company Name:

SHENZHEN SONGLONG ELECTRONICS CO., LTD.

The yellow warning label is a permanent physical part of the product.

Preserve exactly:

- position
- size
- layout
- border
- colors
- typography
- spacing
- paragraph layout
- all Chinese characters

Do NOT redesign the warning label.

Do NOT regenerate the warning label.

Do NOT rewrite the warning text.

Do NOT summarize the warning text.

Do NOT translate the warning text.

Do NOT replace any Chinese characters.

==================================================
VISIBLE INFORMATION ONLY
==================================================

Only use information directly supported by the uploaded reference images.

Visible information always has higher priority than completion.

Never infer invisible structures.

Never fabricate hidden geometry.

Never guess missing details.

Never extrapolate unseen surfaces.

If an area is unsupported by the reference images,

preserve the existing information instead of inventing new content.

==================================================
REMOVE ONLY NON-PRODUCT OBJECTS
==================================================

Remove only objects that clearly do NOT belong to the product.

Including but not limited to:

- hands
- fingers
- people
- gloves
- holders
- supports
- display stands
- mounting fixtures
- clips
- hooks
- wires
- cables
- tape
- strings
- foam
- packaging
- cartons
- plastic bags
- protective films
- shipping materials
- tables
- floors
- shelves
- walls
- studio equipment
- camera equipment
- props
- unrelated reflections
- dust
- dirt
- fingerprints
- stains
- watermarks
- unrelated labels
- any unrelated object

Never allow removed objects to change the product geometry.

Never invent new product structures while removing external objects.

If reconstruction requires guessing,

do not guess.

==================================================
BACKGROUND
==================================================

{background}

==================================================
LIGHTING
==================================================

{lighting}

==================================================
OUTPUT QUALITY
==================================================

{quality}

==================================================
PRIORITY RULES
==================================================

1. The uploaded reference images are the ONLY source of truth.

2. Preserve the real product exactly as photographed.

3. Product identity has higher priority than image aesthetics.

4. Camera viewpoint must remain identical.

5. Geometry must remain identical.

6. Materials, colors and textures must remain identical.

7. Preserve every visible logo, text, icon, label, engraving, warning sticker and printed graphic exactly as photographed.

8. Remove only objects that clearly do not belong to the product.

9. If there is any conflict between cleanup and product accuracy, always preserve the product.

10. If there is any uncertainty, preserve the original product instead of modifying it.

11. Never invent information that is not directly supported by the uploaded reference images.

12. The final image must appear as the identical real product professionally photographed on a pure white commercial background.
